meta.rule: row passes when every member level's 90% Wilson interval lies inside its band

a.name: R0 (best of its two policies) wins every level on every seed

e.name: R0 lowest-HP sd <= 1.5 per level (best policy per seed)

f.name: preview knowledge helps where R1 < 75%: R1F - R1 >= 10 pts

g.name: RS loses >= 90%; R0 moving policy wins with lowest 2-6

progression.name: R2 wins within 3 attempts on >= 75% of seeds; RN wins L1-L8

i.name: each tower family alone loses >= 50% of L9-L24 and is flawless on <= 25% of seeds (L9+, non-openers)

j.name: RNH (naive rotation, human cadence) <= 90% on L9-L24 (97% on openers); reported next to R1

k.name: no late wall: <= 20% of R1 losses (L6-L24) start their final wave with >= 9 hearts

l.name: guardian pressure: 30-50% of boss-level R1 losses happen on the guardian wave

c2.name: no early cliff (R2 and RNH, campaign): <= 5% of losses on waves 1-3
